# Human Consumer Products

> Concepts from human minds, for humans. Original consumer concepts held, developed and licensed, each available to commission in defined stages.

## Andrew Thomas (Leeds, UK)

Originates consumer concepts for a world with abundant intelligence.

- Back the mind: https://humanconsumerproducts.com/#andrew-thomas--back (support, not investment)
- Contact: drewthomasenterprises@gmail.com

### HCP-001 — The caster

A creation device. Say what you want to exist and it forms in light above the table, for everyone at it. Shape it by hand, keep it, or send it to a screen.

- Stage: Concept; rights: Held by originator
- Demonstration: https://humanconsumerproducts.com/#andrew-thomas--caster
- Brief: https://humanconsumerproducts.com/#andrew-thomas--caster--brief
- Commission terms: https://humanconsumerproducts.com/#andrew-thomas--caster--commission

## Commissioning

Stages: working rig; looks-like works-like prototype; engineering prototype; production partner. Commissioners receive first look, build-review seats, credit and first right to license. Enquiries to the originating mind; state the stage of interest.
